info.title: mattergram native HTTP ingress
info.description: Authored SDK boundary for the Mattermost 11.1 baseline; not copied provider documentation.

x-authentication.transport: Explicit trusted peer CIDRs plus an authenticated/controlled server path; forwarded headers ignored.
x-authentication.slash: Constant-time comparison of per-command issued body token, team, command and bound method. Token Authorization, if supplied, must also match.
x-authentication.callback: HMAC-SHA256 canonical context with expiry and native scope binding; does not independently authenticate actor fields outside context.

200.description: One completed native response or explicit empty ephemeral JSON ACK

500.description: Handler failure or invalid response lifecycle

get.description: Only bindings explicitly configured for GET; native slash fields in the query. Disable URL access logging.

200.description: Same response lifecycle and authentication as POST

403.description: Unbound GET method or invalid authentication

200.description: Native update, ephemeral_text, skip_slack_parsing, or empty JSON ACK

403.description: Untrusted transport, invalid or expired signature, rejected scope or selection
